text: The same idea appears all over the syllabus. Ammonium chloride suppresses ammonium hydroxide. Hydrochloric acid suppresses hydrogen sulphide. Sodium chloride lowers the solubility of silver chloride. And hydrogen chloride gas makes pure salt crystallise from brine.
